title: Verification & Cross-Reference Methodology
description: How Pin2Pin Global extracts, Dual-Path 300 DPI Vision-verifies, physics-checks, and deterministically compares semiconductor datasheets from official manufacturer PDFs.

sections.heading: Stage 0: Official Manufacturer Sourcing & PDF Quality Gate
paragraphs: Accurate cross-referencing begins with document provenance. Every Orderable Part Number (OPN) in the Pin2Pin Global database is tied to two official manufacturer URLs: the direct manufacturer datasheet PDF URL and the official product landing page URL. Distributor websites and third-party datasheet aggregators are strictly forbidden at the schema level.

Before any extraction occurs, our Stage 0 ingestion classifier evaluates text density and page structure across the official PDF. Low-resolution scanned images or legacy documents lacking a reliable machine-readable text layer are never guessed or forced through noisy OCR — they are immediately quarantined as UNSUPPORTED_SCAN and blocked from publication.
bullets: Zero distributor scraping: DigiKey, Mouser, LCSC, Octopart, and aggregator domains are hard-blocked in our Zod v2 URL validator.
Immutable provenance metadata: Every part record stores datasheet revision, SHA-256 audit hash, page count, official source domain, and verification date.
Automatic quarantine: Image-only or degraded PDFs exit with UNSUPPORTED_SCAN and fail the publish gate.

sections.heading: Stage 1 & Stage 2: Dual-Path Extraction (Text + 300 DPI PNG Vision)
paragraphs: Relying on text extraction alone is a well-known failure mode for semiconductor PDFs: pinout diagrams are frequently drawn as vector graphics where text parsers scramble pin numbers, overbars on active-low shutdown pins disappear, and multi-variant electrical tables suffer from column shifts across temperature grades or package suffixes.

To eliminate single-path extraction blind spots, Pin2Pin Global enforces a Dual-Path verification architecture. Path A extracts structured text and tables with explicit [PAGE N] citations. In parallel, Path B renders the exact Pin Configuration, Absolute Maximum Ratings, Thermal Information, and Electrical Characteristics pages at 300 DPI PNG resolution for direct visual cross-inspection.

Every numeric specification — from quiescent current (Iq) and dropout voltage (Vdo) to thermal resistance (theta_JA), switching frequency (fsw), enable-pin absolute maximum ratings, and input bias current (Ib) — must carry its exact PDF page number and test condition. Any discrepancy between Path A text and Path B 300 DPI visual inspection triggers re-extraction; parts that cannot reach >= 95% verified confidence are isolated for human review rather than published.
bullets: Two-tier Family 1:N OPN schema: Each JSON record locks a single orderable part number to exactly one JEDEC package code, one pinout view (TOP_VIEW or BOTTOM_VIEW), and one exposed thermal pad net.

300 DPI Vision pinout audit: Every pin 1..N (name, functional role, and physical orientation) and every thermal tab net (such as SOT-223-3 VOUT vs GND) is visually confirmed on rendered datasheet drawings.

Page-bound citation enforcement: Every cited page number (including design_gotchas citations and pinout_source_page membership in vision_pages_checked) is programmatically checked against the PDF's actual total page count.

sections.heading: Deterministic Physics & Schema Consistency Verifier
paragraphs: Before any part enters the cross-reference engine, it must pass our deterministic Stage 2 Physics Consistency Verifier. Automated software rules catch unit-scale mistakes (such as mV vs V, uA vs mA, or kHz vs MHz) and structural inconsistencies that prose review can miss.
bullets: Voltage & temperature hierarchy checks: Absolute maximum ratings must satisfy V_abs_max >= V_rec_max > V_rec_min >= 0, LDO output voltage must satisfy Vout < Vin_max, and temp_grade must satisfy ta_min < ta_max <= tj_max.
Package & pin-sequence integrity: pinout.length must exactly equal package.pin_count and the canonical JEDEC pin count for that package code, with contiguous pin indices 1 through N.

Exposed pad declaration: Packages with exposed_pad.present = true must explicitly declare their electrical net (GND, VOUT, THERMAL_GND_RECOMMENDED, etc.), while non-EP packages must strictly declare NONE.

Thermal, ESR & switching bounds: Verifies plausible Tj,max (100–185 °C), theta_JA (10–500 °C/W), valid ESR window ordering (esr_min <= esr_max), DC-DC switching frequency (20 kHz–10 MHz), and distinct comparator propagation delay vs op-amp GBWP/slew-rate fields.
Information-gain floor: Every published part must provide at least 12 distinct, cited electrical and thermal specifications.

sections.heading: Stage 3: Deterministic Cross-Reference & 3-Tier Compatibility Rules
paragraphs: All 1:1 comparison pages (/en/vs/slugA-vs-slugB) are normalized in strict alphabetical order (slugA < slugB) to prevent duplicate mirrored URLs. Compatibility classifications are computed deterministically from verified pinouts, package footprints, exposed pad nets, and electrical ratings — never guessed heuristically. The same rules power our live Interactive Freeform Comparator and Zero-Upload BOM Checker.
bullets: Level 3 — PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch): Automatically assigned whenever pin counts differ, footprints are physically incompatible (e.g., SOT-23-3 vs SOT-223-3), any power/signal pin role conflicts, or exposed thermal pad/tab nets disagree (e.g., Tab = VOUT vs Tab = GND).

Level 2 — Functional / Tuning Required (Check Passives & Ratings): Assigned when the PCB footprint is compatible (including SOT-23-5 vs TSOT-23-5 with explicit Z-height caution) but electrical tuning or circuit updates are mandatory — such as LDO ceramic-capacitor ESR stability differences, Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS conflicts, Enable polarity or EN voltage-ceiling mismatches, >20% Vin/Iout rating drops, DC-DC switching frequency shifts >30% or Vref changes, or Op-Amp push-pull vs Comparator open-collector output stages.

Level 1 — Candidate Drop-In (Verify Datasheet Before Production): Awarded strictly when footprint, pinout, exposed pad net, device topology/output stage, stability class, and core voltage/current ratings align. Even Level 1 pairs display thermal, ESD, and datasheet-revision verification checks.

sections.heading: Continuous Automated QA Gate & Public Issue Tracking
paragraphs: High-risk packages — particularly 3-pin SOT-23-3 LDOs with standard vs reversed ordering suffixes, SOT-223-3 thermal-tab regulators, SOT-23-6 bucks with 7–8 V EN clamps, and SOT-23-5 single op-amps with U-suffix permutations — undergo targeted 1:1 visual audits against official manufacturer PDFs. We enforce a zero-tolerance defect threshold for pinout, absolute maximum rating, and unit errors.

Before every static release, our 7-gate Stage 5 QA harness validates every canonical English page across our growing catalog (currently 80 verified OPNs, 11 deep engineering field guides, 7 interactive tools, and all generated comparison and alternative hub pages), enforcing sitemap completeness, zero rendering anomalies (zero broken numeric tokens or empty table cells), mandatory AUD-04 disclaimers, valid JSON-LD structured data, zero broken internal links, and verified SVG pinout diagrams. Readers can inspect or report any discrepancy directly via our public GitHub Issues tracker (https://github.com/kbu3986/pin2pin-global/issues).
